rationale: dual_domain_supervised-claude-agentic: unet_c=16, epochs=44, batch_size=1, lr=0.001, optimizer=adam, lambda_neg=0.03, grad_clip=1.0, train_n=400, val_n=200, val_chunk=10, seed=48, rationale=iter-19 dual_domain_supervised, re-split Breast-CT val=200. SIX-BOX at BEST config (c16/ep44/lr1e-3/lneg0.03/bs1/tn400). (1) PRIOR: 6 seed replicates -- 42=0.8915,43=0.8589,44=0.8317,45=0.8866,46=0.8844,47=0.7672 -> mean~0.850 sstd~0.047, spread 0.124. Seed variance is VERY large and dominant; 0.8915 (seed42) is an upper-tail outlier and 0.7672 (seed47) a low-tail one. (2) Failure mode: single-seed(=42) sweep was noise-confounded -- the iters1-13 knob deltas (~0.88-0.89) sit well within this +-0.05 band, so few are statistically distinguishable. (3) ONE KNOB: seed 48 (7th replicate). (4) HYPOTHESIS: n=7 keeps mean ~0.85+-0.045; honest config number is this mean, NOT the seed-42 peak; the primary reportable finding is the large seed variance itself. (5) BUDGET: ~941s. (6) iter-20 = final (8th) replicate. Artifacts saved.
